title: Courtesy Waivers and Refunds of Pocketwire Pay in 4 Late Fees
content:
A Pocketwire Pay in 4 late fee can be waived as a courtesy at the customer's request, at most the tier's number of courtesy waivers per calendar year, once the late installment is paid; a late fee is waived only if no earlier waiver exists for the same plan and installment.

### Allowances by tier

| Tier | Courtesy late fee waivers per calendar year | Late fees of a plan refunded when the merchant refunds the whole purchase |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | 0 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic | 1 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Select | 1 | No |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Preferred | 1 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Premier | 2 | Yes |
| Pocketwire Pay in 4 Elite | 2 | Yes |

### Conditions of a courtesy waiver

A courtesy waiver of a late fee on one installment of one plan is available when all of the following hold:

1. the customer asks for it;
2. the late installment the fee sits on has been paid;
3. the waivers of late fees recorded on the account with a waiver date in the calendar year containing the day of handling are fewer than the tier's yearly allowance; and
4. the records show no earlier waiver for the same plan and the same installment.

Conditions 2 to 4 are read from the company's records of the plan, its installment payments and its waivers. If any of conditions 2 to 4 is not met, the late fee is not waived as a courtesy. On Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter the yearly allowance is 0, so no courtesy waiver is available on that tier.

A waiver removes the amount waived from what the customer owes on Pocketwire Pay in 4 and is recorded against the plan and installment whose fee it waives.

### Refund of late fees on a full merchant refund

When the merchant refunds the whole purchase behind a plan, that plan's late fees are refunded on the tiers marked Yes in the table above.

### Truth table (hypothetical account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Classic, yearly allowance 1)

| Customer asks | Late installment paid | Waivers already this calendar year | Earlier waiver for same plan and installment | Courtesy waiver |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 0 | No | Available |
| Yes | No | 0 | No | Not yet — the installment is unpaid |
| Yes | Yes | 1 | No | Not available — yearly allowance used |
| Yes | Yes | 0 | Yes | Not available — already waived |

### Points of judgement

- The yearly count follows the calendar year of the day of handling: a waiver dated in an earlier calendar year does not use this year's allowance.
- The one-waiver rule is tied to the plan and the installment number together; a waiver on installment 2 of a plan does not stand in the way of a waiver on installment 3 of the same plan, subject to the yearly allowance.
